from kohakutpu.application.ktpugrad.attention import attention

def reference(q, k, v):
    q, k, v = (a.astype(np.float32) for a in (q, k, v))
    s = (q @ k.swapaxes(-1, -2)) * np.float32(0.125)
    e = np.exp(s - s.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    return (e / e.sum(-1, keepdims=True)) @ v
